title: AutoMegaKernel: A Statically-Checked Agent Harness for Self-Retargeting Megakernel Synthesis
title_zh: AutoMegaKernel：用于自重定向 Megakernel 合成的静态检查 Agent Harness
abstract_en: AutoMegaKernel (AMK) compiles a HuggingFace Llama-family model into a single persistent cooperative CUDA kernel that runs the whole forward pass in one launch, with no per-model hand-written CUDA. The contribution is the system, not raw speed. A frozen schedule-IR validator statically certifies deadlock-freedom and race-freedom via static graph checks (not a mechanized proof), so an unsafe agent-proposed schedule is rejected before launch: across 7,160 adversarial schedules (6,091 unsafe) it had zero false-accepts and accepted all 360 real lowerings. The same source retargets sm_80/sm_90/sm_120 from one codebase, auto-generates correct megakernels for 10 of 10 supported models, and on a real SmolLM2-135M checkpoint reproduces HuggingFace greedy decode token-for-token (perplexity match 2.5e-7). An unattended, agent-drivable autoresearch loop self-improves the megakernel over its own baseline (1.25-1.72x). A search-found int8 (W8A16) megakernel beats CUDA-graphed cuBLAS bf16 at batch-1 decode across NVIDIA's datacenter inference fleet: L4 up to 1.33x, the current-gen L40S 1.25-1.27x, A10G up to 1.08x at scale, and the consumer RTX 5090 1.19-1.23x. The ordering is not a clean function of bandwidth (the 864 GB/s L40S beats the 600 GB/s A10G); the divide is inference-class vs training-class. AMK trails cuBLAS on the high-bandwidth training-class A100/H100, where the harness localizes the cross-SM-sync bottleneck; we report the gap plainly. This is a precision-asymmetric (W8A16 vs bf16) comparison at decode position 0; the largest real checkpoint is TinyLlama-1.1B. Code and the harness: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/AutoMegaKernel
abstract_zh: AutoMegaKernel（AMK）将 HuggingFace Llama-family 模型编译为单个持久协作式 CUDA kernel，使整个 forward pass 在一次 launch 中完成，且无需为每个模型手写 CUDA。论文的核心贡献是系统能力而非单纯速度：其冻结的 schedule-IR validator 通过静态图检查，在 launch 前验证无死锁与无数据竞争，从而拒绝不安全的 agent 生成调度。在 7,160 个对抗调度中，AMK 对 6,091 个不安全调度实现零误接受，并接受全部 360 个真实 lowering。系统可从同一代码库重定向到 sm_80、sm_90、sm_120，自动为 10/10 个支持模型生成正确 megakernel，并在真实 SmolLM2-135M checkpoint 上与 HuggingFace greedy decode 逐 token 一致。其无人值守、agent 可驱动的 autoresearch loop 可相对基线自改进 1.25–1.72x。搜索得到的 int8（W8A16）megakernel 在 batch-1 decode 上，在多款 NVIDIA 推理级 GPU 上超过 CUDA-graphed cuBLAS bf16，但在 A100/H100 等高带宽训练级 GPU 上落后，瓶颈被定位为跨 SM 同步。论文也明确指出比较存在精度不对称（W8A16 vs bf16）、测试位于 decode position 0，最大真实 checkpoint 为 TinyLlama-1.1B。
key_points_zh: 提出 AutoMegaKernel，将 Llama-family 模型编译成单次 launch 的 persistent cooperative CUDA megakernel，目标是自动化系统生成而非依赖手写 CUDA。
设计冻结的 schedule-IR validator，通过静态图检查验证 deadlock-freedom 与 race-freedom；在 7,160 个对抗调度上零 false-accept，并接受全部真实 lowering。
同一代码库可重定向到 sm_80、sm_90、sm_120，并为 10/10 个支持模型自动生成正确 megakernel；在 SmolLM2-135M 上与 HuggingFace greedy decode 逐 token 匹配。
构建 agent-drivable autoresearch loop，可无人值守地优化自身 megakernel，相比内部基线提升 1.25–1.72x。
搜索得到的 W8A16 int8 megakernel 在 L4、L40S、A10G、RTX 5090 等推理/消费级 GPU 的 batch-1 decode 上超过 CUDA-graphed cuBLAS bf16，但在 A100/H100 上受跨 SM 同步瓶颈影响仍落后。

llm_assessment.comment: Technically interesting statically checked agent-driven compiler optimization work, but its relevance to general agent harness evolution is indirect.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作在代理驱动编译优化和静态校验方面有技术亮点，但与通用 agent harness 演进的关系较间接。
